Hi. Since you’re new here,

let’s find out what you’re into.

what kind of things are you into?

today you’ll
  • talk about your free time and your habits, then and now
  • describe films, books and music
  • listen to people talking about films

Outcomes B2
Unit 1A, Entertainment

1

this or that?

Pick one in each pair and say why. We both answer.

I’m really into…I tend to…I hardly ever…Not as much as I’d like to.
2

do you … much?

Listen to eight people. What question was each person asked? Write it.

3

how we talk about habits

Read the examples in the box. Then sort the phrases: tap a phrase, then tap its group.

4

one word missing

Choose the missing word for each gap. Then check.

Which sentences are true for you? Change the others so they are.

5

how have your habits changed?

Choose two or three cards. Tell me how things used to be and how they are now.

work

What did a normal working day use to look like?

What do you tend to do on a typical day now?

study

How would you study at school or university?

How do you tend to learn new things now?

holidays

Where would your family go on holiday when you were a child?

Where do you tend to go now?

eating

What did you use to eat a lot that you hardly ever eat now?

What do you eat all the time these days?

family

What would you do with your family at weekends?

What do you do together now, and how often?

toolbox

I used to…I didn’t use to…We’d…These days I tend to…I hardly ever……all the time…every now and thenAs a rule, I…Not as much as I used to.
6

you and english

Finish each sentence so it’s true for you, then tell me a bit more. Tap a note when you’ve said it.

7

describing films, music and books

Choose a word for each sentence. Then say the sentences out loud. Stress the repeated word: It’s catchy, really, really catchy.

8

guess the adjective

Draw a card and keep it secret. Say two or three words or phrases you connect with the adjective. Your partner guesses it. Take turns.

your secret word

gripping

9

name it!

card 1

Give a real example from your life, then say more about it.

Describe it twice for emphasis: It was gripping, really, really gripping. I watched the whole season in two days.

Who did you watch it with?Would you watch it again?Would you recommend it to me?
10

two people talking about films

first listen: exercise 9

second listen: exercise 10

your turn

  1. Do you go to the cinema much? Where do you tend to go?
  2. What kind of films are you mainly into?
  3. Have you seen anything good recently?
  4. What did you think of it?
11

let me be your tour guide

Fill in your profile. Then present it to me, as if you’re showing me around your world.

Hi. Since you’re new here, let me be your tour guide.

This is

you

these days I’m really into
at the weekend I tend to
then and now
on repeat
couldn’t stop watching
a book I’d recommend
my tip for you

and that’s a wrap.
